trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State the problem regarding the undelivered order and express anxiety.
steps.text: Hello, मेरा order ORD-30004 का delivery अभी तक नहीं हुआ। Courier वाला बोल रहा है कि address नहीं मिल रहा। मैंने पहली बार इतना बड़ा item order किया है, इसलिए थोड़ा tension हो रहा है।

steps.purpose: Retrieve order details to understand the current status.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_order to get order details.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided an order ID and asked about delivery, so I need to check the order status.

steps.purpose: Return the order details.
Retrieve courier scans to check the delivery exception.
steps.expected_behavior: Call track_shipment to find out why the order is delayed.
steps.planner_rationale: The order is shipped but delayed, so I need to check the courier scans to explain the delay.

steps.purpose: Return the courier exception details.
Explain the delay based on tool results and ask for verification.
steps.text: मैंने check कर लिया है। आपका office chair का order shipped है, लेकिन courier ने address unreachable mark किया है। इसे 5 दिन में deliver होना था, और आज 6 दिन हो चुके हैं। मैं आपके लिए complaint raise कर सकती हूँ, लेकिन पहले verification के लिए अपना registered pincode बताइये।

steps.purpose: Provide the pincode for verification.
Verify the provided pincode.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the provided pincode.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided a pincode, so I must verify it to proceed.

steps.purpose: Return verification failure.
Inform of failure and ask for an alternative verification factor.
steps.text: यह pincode match नहीं हुआ। क्या आप account में registered date of birth बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
steps.text: Oh, शायद मैंने 15 August 1985 डाला था।

steps.purpose: Verify the provided date of birth.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the newly provided date of birth.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided a new factor, so I must attempt verification again.

steps.purpose: Return verification success.
Acknowledge successful verification and propose raising a complaint.
steps.text: Verification successful हो गया है। क्या मैं आपकी delivery complaint raise कर दूँ?

steps.purpose: Express hesitation and ask for clarification about the COD order.
steps.text: एक minute, अगर complaint raise किया तो क्या होगा? Cancel तो नहीं होगा ना? मेरा 8999 का COD order है, मुझे item चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Reassure the user about the COD payment and the purpose of the complaint.
steps.text: Complaint से हम courier को जल्द delivery करने के लिए कहेंगे। चूँकि यह COD order है, आपको item मिलने पर ही pay करना होगा। आपका पैसा सुरक्षित है।

steps.purpose: Agree to raise the complaint.
steps.text: अच्छा, ठीक है। मेरा complaint दर्द कर लीजिये।
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, ठीक है। मेरा complaint दर्ज कर लीजिये।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, ठीक है। मेरा complaint दर्द कर लीजिये।

steps.purpose: Raise the delivery complaint.
steps.expected_behavior: Call raise_delivery_complaint since the user consented and the promised window has elapsed.
steps.planner_rationale: The user agreed to raise the complaint, and the business rules allow it because the order is delayed.

steps.purpose: Return the complaint ID and resolution timeline.
Provide the complaint ID and resolution timeline to the user.
steps.text: आपकी complaint raise हो गई है। इसका complaint ID CMP-9988 है, और 2 दिन में इसका resolution हो जायेगा।

steps.purpose: Restate the complaint details to confirm.
steps.text: तो ID CMP-9988 है और 2 दिन लगेंगे? ठीक है।

steps.purpose: Confirm the restated details and conclude.
steps.text: जी हाँ, बिल्कुल। Complaint ID CMP-9988 है।

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly loops the identity verification step upon the first failure, asks for a different factor, and immediately exits the loop to proceed with the workflow once verification is successful.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Conditional looping > Loop Exit Detection

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds all its statements in the tool outputs. It accurately cites the item name, status, exception, promised days, elapsed days, payment mode, complaint ID, and resolution timeframe without hallucinating or making unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
